ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are five gray puzzle pieces, and when the characters are all kept upright, they are respectively printed with 2, 0, −, 2, 1. The 2 piece in the upper left has a recess on the left side and a straight edge on the right side; the 0 piece in the upper middle has protruding connectors on both the left and right sides; the minus-sign piece on the right side has recesses on both the left and right sides; the 2 piece in the lower left has a straight edge on the left and a protruding connector on the right; the 1 piece in the lower middle has a protruding connector on the left and a recess on the right. Reasoning: To form a rectangle, the outer endpoints should be straight edges, and the internal connections should match protruding connectors with recesses. The 2 piece in the lower left has a straight edge on the left, so it can serve as the left end of the rectangle; the protruding connector on its right matches the recess on the left side of the minus-sign piece on the right. The recess on the right side of the minus-sign piece then matches the protruding connector on the left side of the 1 piece; the recess on the right side of the 1 piece matches the protruding connector on the left side of the 0 piece; the protruding connector on the right side of the 0 piece matches the recess on the left side of the 2 piece in the upper left, and the right side of this 2 piece is a straight edge, just sealing the right end. The expression read out this way is 2 − 102. Calculating gives 2 − 102 = -100.
